newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: OB Brewery, Doo San Bev fall.
newsitem.headline: OB Brewery, Doo San Bev fall.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's OB Brewery Co and its sister firm Doo San Beverage Co fell to their daily limits in Wednesday's morning trading after Tuesday's announcement that OB would absorb Doo San, brokers said.
At 0135 GMT, OB Brewery was down 2,400 won to 28,600 and Doo San down 2,700 won to 32,000, but trading was slow.

"Prices of the two stocks rose sharply recently on similar rumours, and now investors are selling them to take profit," said Koh Soon-shik of LG Securities. "Investors also think the merger would not give any big immediate boost to the share prices of the companies."
On Tuesday, OB Brewery said the absorption would take place on October 1 if the plan is approved at shareholders' meetings due in early July.
